slides.texte_overlay:
How to train your brain
to be quicker and smarter
Play games that make you think fast. Chess blitz, card games, quick puzzles. Speed under pressure trains your brain to process faster.
Learn a musical instrument. Reading notes, moving your hands and listening all at once is one of the best workouts your brain can get.
Memorise something every week. A poem, a speech, a list of capitals. Memory gets stronger the more you use it. Teaching is the best test.
Explain complex ideas simply. Try explaining how the internet works to a child. Simplifying forces you to understand deeply.
Before: my brain felt slow and foggy. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I think faster and remember more.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: my brain felt slow and foggy. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I think faster and remember more.

slides.texte_overlay: Change your routine on purpose. A new route to work, a new recipe, a new sport. Novelty keeps your brain active and alert.
Rest properly. Sleep, breaks and time without screens are when your brain recovers. A rested mind is always a sharper mind.
